title: Design: Edit Customer's Sales Representative field and list look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C, so the list has several names to sort.
  • Create a customer for this test with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "customer-03-n2-edit.png" (board 2.3), "customer-04-n2-edit-list.png" (board 2.4) and "customer-05-n2-edit-picked.png" (board 2.5) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the customer's page in that browser window.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer and compare the field with the picture of board 2.3.
  2. Open the field's list and compare with the picture of board 2.4.
  3. Pick sales rep A and compare with the picture of board 2.5.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • There is one "Sales Representative" field, reading "Unassigned".
  • It has the same outlined box as every other field in the window.
  • It is in the place Edit Customer shows it today.
  • The + shows beside it without hovering.
  • The arrow is vertically centred.
  • There is no x inside the field.

Step 2:

  • "Unassigned" is first, then the representatives, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z.
  • There is no search box.

Step 3:

  • The field reads sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”
  • S4-R3: “Its dropdown starts with "Unassigned", followed by every staff member whose Sales Representative switch is on and whose account is active, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z, as on the work order (S1-R8). Every one of them is listed, however many there are. It has no search box (S1-R12). The same list shows when the New Customer window is opened from a part sale by a user who can create part sales but not customers.”
  • S4-R4: “No field in the window has an x inside it; picking "Unassigned" clears it (S1-R10). Each field's dropdown arrow is vertically centered (S1-R11). In the window the + and the remove x are always shown; they do not wait for hover.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 15: “15. (a) "Unassigned" first, then A to Z by first name, then last name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.3 Edit Customer: one field and the +; 2.4 The list: Unassigned first; 2.5 One rep picked (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: The design's list shows names out of A to Z order (board 2.4; the canvas says its test copy lists login names). Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 for the PRD's A to Z by first name, then last name (answer 15, quoted above); this case follows it.

Design pictures attached to this case: customer-03-n2-edit.png, customer-04-n2-edit-list.png, customer-05-n2-edit-picked.png.
